title: Gordon Cooper's book: von Braun worked on UFO craft in Nazi Germany
summary: Robert Salas tells of Gordon Cooper's book: von Braun worked on UFO craft in Nazi Germany, about 1940s at Nazi Germany, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Gordon Cooper wrote a book, and in that book, he talks about, um, van Braun telling him that they actually worked on on UFO craft in Germany, Nazi Germany.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, says that Gordon Cooper, an American astronaut, wrote a book describing a talk with Wernher von Braun, the German rocket scientist. According to Salas, Cooper writes that von Braun told him they had actually worked on UFO craft in Nazi Germany in the 1940s. If true, it would mean UFO-like craft were being built by humans during the Second World War.
